title: Credit & Recovery Officer
description:
Assess customer creditworthiness by reviewing financial information, credit history, income, and repayment capacity. Process and verify credit applications in accordance with company policies and lending guidelines. Monitor customer accounts to identify overdue payments, outstanding balances, and potential credit risks. Contact customers through calls, emails, and other channels to follow up on overdue payments. Negotiate repayment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved guidelines. Maintain accurate records of collections, payment commitments, follow-ups, and recovery actions. 

Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: backup,performance tuning,team management,collection management,recovery,patching,sales,recovery operations
